dedupe_keys.name: neural network approximated daily load profile data

description: Richard Asiamah at Georgia Institute of Technology publishes training inputs and predicted daily electricity-load profiles for countries lacking observations. The June 2026 deposit lists separate known, unknown and predicted load-profile workbooks, freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Training material was assembled from research papers and energy-agency reports, and a neural network estimates the missing profiles. These data can supply provisional demand shapes for synthetic grids, network expansion or renewable-integration simulations. Predicted profiles must be distinguished from observed inputs. The public metadata do not establish the country list, observation years, normalisation, hourly units or prediction uncertainty, and no executable network model is listed. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the compilation. Source comparability and model generalisation require checking before transferring the estimates to a specific system. Workbooks were not downloaded or independently assessed.
